query:
SELECT b.id        AS "id!",
                   b.part_id   AS "part_id!",
                   b.version   AS "version!"
            FROM t_part_batch b
            WHERE b.status     = 'DELIVERED'
              AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM t_part_event e
                  WHERE e.batch_id = b.id
                    AND e.event_type = 'DELIVERED'
                    AND e.created_at < $1
              )
            ORDER BY b.id ASC
